name: Personal Website
details: Designed and developed a personal website to showcase my projects, experience, and background.
Implemented a responsive design using Tailwind CSS and built the application using Svelte and TypeScript for a modern and efficient user experience.

name: SCADA for the Virginia Spaceport Authority (VSA)
details: As the project manager, I am leading a group of six computer engineers to develop a Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system for the Virginia Spaceport Authority.
This system will provide alerts for abnormal values and day-to-day monitoring and of various sensors located on a rocket launchpad.

name: MIPS Simulator (simmips)
details: The MIPS simulator is capable of simulating program execution of a selected subset of MIPS assembly source code. It will eventually contain a text user interface and a MIPS virtual machine.
Utilized test driven development (TDD) practices and object oriented programming (OOP) patterns to create a medium scale standalone application from the ground up.
MIPS Simulator is currently being developed as a semester-long project for ECE 3574: Applied Software Design.

name: face.report
details: The project was designed over 24 continuous hours as part of HackViolet 2023, winning 2nd overall.
face.report searches the web for any online photos that are similar to the user, informing on possibly unwanted usage of their likeliness.
Led a team of four to create a full stack application consisting of a Svelte and Flask front-end coupled to a Python facial recognition back-end.

name: Autonomous Tractor
details: The autonomous tractor is a small battery-powered vehicle capable of autonomously driving on a track. It utilizes a path smoothing algorithm and is capable of stopping and turning.

Worked primarily on manipulating infrared sensor data to turn and stop the tractor. Also responsible for utilizing Bluetooth protocols to transfer data from a GUI located on a host computer remotely to the tractor.
The Autonomous Tractor was developed as a semester-long project for ECE 2804: Integrated Design Project.

name: LIFTai
details: Submitted to the VTHacks X Hackathon, where the application won awards for best UI/UX.
Given data in the form of workout exercises, the Python algorithm will fill out the rest of the workout so that an optimal workout targeting all necessary workout groups can be completed.
Developed a front-end web application written in Django to neatly present findings from the algorithm along with associated videos.

name: Talk To Me Now Bot
details: Mental health and positive affirmation application.

name: Where's My Bus?
details: EastBanc Transportation Solution Winner. Python application created by utilizing an API to show bus times and routes. Used Flask framework to display in webpage.
